svg.text: Sampling folds the frequency axis like a paper strip: up to fs/2 (Nyquist) frequencies are seen as they are, above it they come back down, zig-zag. Dots: the tidal constituents. M2
(12.42 h) and N2 sit near 2 cpd, almost exactly twice the daily rate, so read once a day they fold to almost zero: a slow, fake wave. Hover a dot for its apparent period. Engineers
put an analogue low-pass filter before every ADC for this reason.
